newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast to hold Agriculture show in late 1997.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast to hold Agriculture show in late 1997.

text.p: Ivory Coast will hold an Agriculture show from November 27 to December 7 1997 with 600 stands for local, regional and international exhibitors, an Agriculture Ministry statement said.

"The show, an International Salon on Agriculture and Animal Resources (SERA 97) forms part of a range of other intitiatives aimed at integrating agriculture in the sub-region," Agriculture Minister Kouassi Konan Lambert said in a statement.

"In addition to traditional northern suppliers, Europe and North America, the salon will target suppliers of technology from countries such as India, China and Brazil proposing technical solutions suited to our environment," Kouassi added.
The show will be held at a site on the edge of Abidjan.

SERA would provide windows on livestock, forestry, fishing and transport. It is aimed at deeper West African regional agricultural integration as well as opening up trade with South America and Asia, the statement said. -- Matthew Bunce, Abidjan newsroom + 225 21 90 90
